headline: Jefferies issues bullish targets for Sunteck Realty, Radico Khaitan, and others
hook: Brokerage picks with up to 64% upside
summary: Brokerage firm Jefferies has released positive target prices for several Indian companies, projecting an upside of up to 64%. The featured stocks include Sunteck Realty, Radico Khaitan, WeWork India, Supreme Industries, and Kajaria Ceramics. Such brokerage notes often influence short-term buying interest and institutional volumes in these counters. Retail investors holding or tracking these stocks should examine the underlying fundamentals supporting these ambitious targets.
why_it_matters: Potential short-term momentum for recommended stocks
winners_losers: Listed company shareholders gain / cautious investors unaffected

headline: Kajaria Ceramics reports strong Q2 2026 sales and profit growth
hook: Kajaria Ceramics beats Q2 profit expectations
summary: Kajaria Ceramics reported its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026, exceeding analyst expectations for both revenue and net profit. The company saw improved sales performance despite broader market challenges in the construction sector. This growth reflects operational efficiency and steady demand for its tile products. Retail investors should note the company's ability to maintain margins in a competitive building materials market.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings may support share price momentum for ceramic manufacturers.
winners_losers: Kajaria Ceramics gains / Competitors face pressure

headline: Kajaria Ceramics declares Rs 12 interim dividend for FY 2027
summary: Kajaria Ceramics announced an interim dividend of Rs 12 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27, approved by its board of directors. The payout rewards existing shareholders as part of the company's capital allocation strategy. Retail investors holding the stock as of the record date will receive the cash dividend directly.
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited directly to shareholders' bank accounts.

headline: Earnings watch: Kotak Bank, AU Small Finance, and others report Q2 results
hook: Eight major firms report Q2 earnings today
summary: Several prominent companies are scheduled to release their September quarter financial results on October 24, 2026. The list includes major financial institutions like Kotak Mahindra Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, and IDFC First Bank. Industrial and tech players such as JK Cement, Netweb Technologies, Castrol India, and Kajaria Ceramics are also reporting. These results provide insight into the current performance of the banking and manufacturing sectors.
whats_next: Results will be released throughout the trading day on October 24, 2026.
why_it_matters: Stock prices for these companies may fluctuate based on earnings surprises.

headline: Kajaria Ceramics to hold investor meetings in Mumbai
hook: Kajaria Ceramics schedules Mumbai investor meet
summary: Kajaria Ceramics has announced an investor meet scheduled for October 27-28 in Mumbai. The company will engage with institutional investors and analysts during these sessions. Such meetings typically involve discussions regarding operational performance, market demand, and future growth strategies. Retail investors should note that management commentary from these events often influences institutional sentiment toward the stock.
why_it_matters: Institutional sentiment may shift based on management's outlook shared here.

headline: Kajaria Ceramics clarifies media reports on potential acquisition
hook: Unverified reports spark stake sale chatter
summary: Kajaria Ceramics has issued a clarification in response to recent media reports regarding a potential acquisition. The company addressed the speculation under Regulation 30(11) of SEBI listing regulations. Such clarifications are routine compliance procedures when unconfirmed market rumours circulate. Retail investors should note that the company has addressed the reports, helping clarify its current stance on the matter.
why_it_matters: Clarification dispels acquisition rumours affecting short-term stock volatility

headline: Axis Bank, Varun Beverages and three others recommended by Bajaj Broking
hook: Brokerage flags five short-term trading bets
summary: Technical analyst Pabitro Mukherjee from Bajaj Broking has recommended five stocks for short-term gains based on chart patterns and momentum indicators. The selected equities include Axis Bank, Varun Beverages, Sudarshan Chemical Industries, Kajaria Ceramics, and EPL. Investors typically track such analyst recommendations for short-term momentum trading opportunities in these specific counters.
why_it_matters: Short-term trading opportunities open in five highlighted stocks
